# Unfinished Work Audit

> Audit local Codex and Claude sessions against repositories to find genuinely unfinished work.

## Primary instructions

- SKILL.md: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/unfinished-work-audit/blob/main/SKILL.md
- Installation: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/unfinished-work-audit/blob/main/docs/install.md
- Update: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/unfinished-work-audit/blob/main/docs/update.md

## Install

`npx skills add Fable-Forge/unfinished-work-audit`
